pairs.spanish: Dobrý den, jak se máte?
pairs.english: Good day, how are you?

pairs.spanish: Jmenuji se Petr a jsem z České republiky.
pairs.english: My name is Petr and I am from the Czech Republic.

pairs.spanish: Moc mě těší, že vás poznávám.
pairs.english: Very nice to meet you.

pairs.spanish: Pocházím z Brna, ale teď bydlím v Praze.
pairs.english: I come from Brno, but now I live in Prague.

pairs.spanish: Mluvím anglicky a trochu česky.
pairs.english: I speak English and a little Czech.

pairs.spanish: Dám si kávu s mlékem a jablečný závin, prosím.
pairs.english: I will have a coffee with milk and an apple strudel, please.

pairs.spanish: Kolik to stojí?
pairs.english: How much does this cost?

pairs.spanish: Můžu zaplatit kartou?
pairs.english: Can I pay by card?

pairs.spanish: Zaplatím, prosím.
pairs.english: I would like to pay, please.

pairs.spanish: Toto jídlo je velmi chutné.
pairs.english: This food is very tasty.

pairs.spanish: Každý den vstávám v sedm hodin ráno.
pairs.english: Every day I get up at seven in the morning.

pairs.spanish: Piju čaj a snídám v kuchyni.
pairs.english: I drink tea and eat breakfast in the kitchen.

pairs.spanish: Do práce jezdím tramvají nebo metrem.
pairs.english: I go to work by tram or metro.

pairs.spanish: Večer rád čtu knihu nebo poslouchám hudbu.
pairs.english: In the evening I like to read a book or listen to music.

pairs.spanish: Moje rodina bydlí na Moravě.
pairs.english: My family lives in Moravia.

pairs.spanish: Promiňte, kde je nejbližší stanice metra?
pairs.english: Excuse me, where is the nearest metro station?

pairs.spanish: Včera jsme byli s přáteli v Národním divadle.
pairs.english: Yesterday we were at the National Theatre with friends.

pairs.spanish: Příští víkend pojedeme na výlet do Krkonoš.
pairs.english: Next weekend we will go on a trip to the Krkonoše mountains.

pairs.spanish: Kdybych měl více volného času, učil bych se hrát na klavír.
pairs.english: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano.

pairs.spanish: Přestože pršelo celý den, procházka historickým centrem se nám líbila.
pairs.english: Although it rained all day, we enjoyed the walk through the historic centre.
